Yeah a payload event would be very very useful for us 🙏 There might be others too, i'll have a look - ty for ping there's probably several others that's worth adding we should only add whats needed, the more we add to that stream the less accurate it'll be unless we go OTT with timestamps etc fair, does any events get deprecated with gloas? 🤔 i haven't scanned them but woudl be worth looking i do think with all the data changes theres likely to be a different set of events needed to get all the metric fun that is in use, but still catching up on the current epbs spec
